assertion: SVG filters operate on the group before clipping and masking; opacity and blending apply to that result. Isolation contains descendant blends and the outer SVG isolates its contents from the page.

browser.reason: Compositing 1 sections 3.3 and 8.3 define the SVG root as isolated. Firefox follows that interpretation for both input paths; Chrome blends inline SVG with the page, but isolates SVG images. WebKit also differs in SVG CSS filter handling. Reviewed differences from Firefox are filter/alpha rounding (most within 2 channels) and antialiased curved edges, maximum 22 channels. Solid regions and group ordering match.
